name: AIBin competitor-informed task coverage
method: Forty task selections (five per eight competitors), deduplicated by user intent. These are public popularity or featured/category signals, not a verified top-five traffic ranking. Ahrefs Site Explorer returned Insufficient plan. TAAFT's public ranking could not be accessed. No competitor prompts or paid content were copied; each new instruction and worked example is original. AIBin provides free reusable instructions for third-party chats, not hosted execution, account integrations or media generation.

sources.note: Explains that popularity combines sales, views, favorites, uses and reviews.
Documents book, adventure and language practice use cases.
Independent directory comparison, not traffic data for TAAFT tasks.
Broad consumer demand categories based on a16z rankings.

competitors.name: AIPRM
competitors.signal: Public SEO listing; the five leading entries display usage counts, not visits.

competitors.name: n8n
competitors.signal: Featured trending templates on the public workflow gallery. AIBin supplies chat instructions, not connected n8n executions.

competitors.name: PromptBase
competitors.signal: Editorial adaptations of the first five items in the public trending list, generalized to reusable original creative tasks.

competitors.name: Character.AI
competitors.signal: Official product use cases plus public group-chat examples; no character-level visitor data.

competitors.name: Prompts.chat
competitors.signal: Public trending creative prompts and documented role-based library; editorial selection, not individual visit ranks.

competitors.name: FlowGPT
competitors.signal: Public discovery shortcuts and categories; actual app-level ranking was not available.

competitors.name: Poe
competitors.signal: Public Explore categories and official assistant capabilities, not verified bot traffic rankings.

competitors.name: There's An AI For That
competitors.signal: Direct ranking was inaccessible. Editorial task-discovery candidates informed by the independent directory review and broad consumer demand research; not verified TAAFT top five.

seo-article-writer.example: Draft an article on how a renter can reduce their electricity bill. Target first-time renters; use the utility rate sheet I provide and add a checklist.
seo-article-writer.output: An evidence-based outline, article draft, descriptive title and meta description, plus a fact-check checklist.
seo-article-writer.limit: Review each claim against its source, add first-hand examples and publish only after editorial approval.

seo-faq-builder.example: Create six answers for a small bakery's actual pickup, preorder, cancellation and allergy questions using its supplied policy.
seo-faq-builder.output: A deduplicated question-and-answer set, source references and a list of information gaps.
seo-faq-builder.limit: Verify policies with the business. FAQ markup does not guarantee a search enhancement.

seo-content-gap.example: Compare my local bike-repair service page with three competitors; find useful questions they leave unanswered.
seo-content-gap.output: A comparison matrix, unanswered questions and a prioritized plan for original content.
seo-content-gap.limit: Competitor pages may change; validate real demand in Search Console or a keyword tool.

keyword-strategy.example: Plan search content for a beginner-friendly houseplant care site using these 30 Search Console queries.
keyword-strategy.output: Query intent clusters, page mappings, a priority order and a measurement plan.
keyword-strategy.limit: A chat model does not have reliable live keyword volumes without a data source.

seo-article-rewriter.example: Refresh my existing article about carry-on packing. Keep my personal packing tips and flag airline rules I need to recheck.
seo-article-rewriter.output: An edited article, a change log and a verification checklist.
seo-article-rewriter.limit: Check ownership and sources; avoid republishing another author's article without permission.

personal-ai-assistant.example: I have two meetings, a grocery run, a deadline at 4 pm and 30 minutes for exercise. Plan my day.
personal-ai-assistant.output: A time-blocked daily plan, priorities, errands and tasks that require your confirmation.
personal-ai-assistant.limit: This is a reusable chat assistant, not a background calendar or email integration.

short-video-prompt.example: Make a 15-second vertical reel promoting a handmade ceramic mug, using my product photo and a warm morning mood.
short-video-prompt.output: A shot list, timed narration, continuity notes and an editable prompt for a video model.
short-video-prompt.limit: Generate or edit footage in an appropriate video tool; review rights, captions and accuracy before posting.

sql-query-assistant.example: Given orders(id, customer_id, created_at, total) and customers(id, region), calculate monthly revenue by region in PostgreSQL.
sql-query-assistant.output: A parameterized SELECT query, explanation and sample expected columns.
sql-query-assistant.limit: Run it in a read-only environment and inspect the query plan; no database connection is provided.

email-organization.example: Here are eight anonymized email subjects and snippets. Sort them into urgent, reply this week, waiting and archive candidates.
email-organization.output: A prioritized inbox table, action items, suggested labels and optional draft replies.
email-organization.limit: No inbox access or automatic labeling is built in; verify senders and deadlines yourself.

social-post-image-prompt.example: Create a square Instagram launch graphic for a neighborhood coffee pop-up with a simple mug illustration and room for a date.
social-post-image-prompt.output: Two layout concepts, editable image prompts, crop and typography notes, and alt text.
social-post-image-prompt.limit: The chat or image generator renders the asset separately; check trademarks and text legibility.

illustration-prompt.example: Create a coordinated set of three geometric botanical illustrations in muted teal, cream and ochre for a reading nook.
illustration-prompt.output: Three original creative directions, a detailed model prompt and a consistent variation recipe.
illustration-prompt.limit: Images are created in an external compatible tool; check usage rights and print resolution.

browser-game-builder.example: Design a simple 3D-style endless obstacle runner playable in a browser with keyboard and touch controls.
browser-game-builder.output: A game specification, starter implementation plan, controls and playtest checklist.
browser-game-builder.limit: A compatible coding chat or development environment is required to produce and run the game.

printable-clipart-prompt.example: Make a six-item winter woodland clipart pack for personal gift tags, in warm watercolor tones, with no text.
printable-clipart-prompt.output: A pack specification, individual prompts, sizing and transparent-background export notes.
printable-clipart-prompt.limit: No downloadable art is generated here; confirm commercial rights and resolution in the image tool.

text-adventure.example: Run a cozy mystery in a seaside town. I play a bookstore owner investigating a missing rare map, with three choices per turn.
text-adventure.output: A playable opening scene, meaningful choices and an evolving game state.
text-adventure.limit: Your external chat maintains the story; save a state summary if you want to resume later.

book-recommendation.example: I liked The Martian and Project Hail Mary. Recommend five optimistic, science-focused novels, without spoilers.
book-recommendation.output: A tailored reading list with authors, reasons each title fits and spoiler-free notes.
book-recommendation.limit: Verify editions and availability in your local library or retailer.

fictional-character-builder.example: Create a fictional space-station librarian who helps players solve gentle science mysteries, with a dry sense of humor.
fictional-character-builder.output: An original reusable character card, opening dialogue and behavior guidelines.
fictional-character-builder.limit: Use a compatible chat for interactive roleplay; this is not a hosted character or real person.

prompt-generator.example: Help me write a reusable prompt to compare three apartments by commute, rent, utilities and pet rules.
prompt-generator.output: A short prompt, a detailed prompt and a validation checklist.
prompt-generator.limit: The prompt is free; results and supported tools depend on the selected AI service.

coding-assistant.example: Write a small JavaScript function that groups expenses by category and handles missing or invalid values. Include tests.
coding-assistant.output: A focused implementation, test cases, assumptions and local run instructions.
coding-assistant.limit: Run tests locally, review dependencies and secrets, and don't deploy unreviewed generated code.

pdf-question-helper.example: Upload a public appliance manual in a compatible chat and ask which maintenance intervals apply to your model. Request page numbers and distinguish direct quotations from explanation.
pdf-question-helper.output: Answers tied to supplied document passages, page references when available and a list of unanswered questions.
pdf-question-helper.limit: AIBin does not upload or read your PDF itself. Use a chat that supports files; redact confidential information and verify citations.

language-practice.example: Practice ordering dinner in Spanish at A2 level. Roleplay a waiter, correct major mistakes after each reply, and give three phrases to review.
language-practice.output: A paced conversation, corrections with explanations and a short vocabulary recap.
language-practice.limit: Voice conversation depends on the external provider; check important translations with reliable sources.

interview-practice.example: Simulate a 20-minute business analyst interview from a pasted job description; ask one question at a time and critique my own examples.
interview-practice.output: Role-specific questions, follow-up probes and feedback on clarity, evidence and structure.
interview-practice.limit: A practice simulation is not a hiring decision; never invent qualifications or share employer secrets.

story-outline-writer.example: Outline a six-chapter cozy mystery set in an original island village, with a surprising but fair solution and distinct supporting characters.
story-outline-writer.output: A premise, character motivations, turning points and chapter outline that the author can revise.
story-outline-writer.limit: Use original characters and plots; review the draft for consistency and rights.

image-prompt-builder.example: Design a prompt for a realistic overhead photo of an original ceramic plate with soft daylight, warm colors and a clean square crop.
image-prompt-builder.output: A descriptive image prompt, composition constraints and optional variations for a compatible image model.
image-prompt-builder.limit: This is a free prompt, not an image generator running on AIBin. Rendering depends on the external tool.

photo-edit-brief.example: Describe edits to a landscape photo: recover highlight detail, brighten foreground shadows and keep colors natural without changing the people or location.
photo-edit-brief.output: An edit brief that distinguishes adjustments to exposure, color and crop from actual content changes.
photo-edit-brief.limit: No photo is edited here. Upload it only to a trusted compatible service and review the actual image.

paragraph-rewriter.example: Rewrite a long customer update into a concise, friendly paragraph for a general audience while keeping the original dates and promises.
paragraph-rewriter.output: A clear revised paragraph and a short explanation of material changes.
paragraph-rewriter.limit: Verify that revised language preserves facts and commitments; don't use it to misrepresent authorship.

research-brief-builder.example: Compare three public sources on home energy efficiency, identifying claims, publication dates and evidence quality before summarizing.
research-brief-builder.output: A concise research brief with cited sources, agreement, uncertainties and follow-up questions.
research-brief-builder.limit: Use a browsing-enabled chat for current sources; manually open citations and verify dates.

resume-builder.example: Create a one-page resume for an entry-level data analyst from my real projects and work history; use the job description to select relevant evidence.
resume-builder.output: An editable resume draft, skill-to-job mapping and a checklist of facts to confirm.
resume-builder.limit: No employment outcomes are guaranteed. Never invent qualifications, metrics or credentials.

slide-outline-builder.example: Outline a seven-slide presentation for a community garden proposal, including budget assumptions, benefits, timeline and a decision request.
slide-outline-builder.output: Slide titles, concise points, visual suggestions and optional speaker notes.
slide-outline-builder.limit: AIBin provides an outline, not a rendered PowerPoint; export through a compatible presentation tool.
